name: Any API MCP Server
description: Dynamically converts any API with an OpenAPI v3 specification into MCP tools for AI assistants. It supports multiple authentication methods including OAuth2, Bearer tokens, and API keys for flexible integration.

rawRecord.description: Dynamically converts any API with an OpenAPI v3 specification into MCP tools for AI assistants. It supports multiple authentication methods including OAuth2, Bearer tokens, and API keys for flexible integration.

API_KEY.description: API Key or identifier used for authentication.

API_URL.description: The base URL of the API to be exposed.

AUTH_TYPE.description: Authentication method to use (none, basic, api-key, bearer-token, bearer-endpoint, oauth2-client-credentials).

API_SECRET.description: API Secret or password used for authentication.

SERVER_NAME.description: Custom name for the MCP server.

AUTH_ENDPOINT.description: Authentication endpoint path (required for bearer-endpoint type).

AUTH_TOKEN_PATH.description: JSON path to the token in the authentication response (e.g., 'token').

OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH.description: Local path to the OpenAPI spec file (JSON or YAML).
